title: Antagonist Duo
description: Targeted antagonist supersets: push-pull pairs for chest and back in harmony

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Brisk in-place march
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place with arm swing

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift torso off the floor, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Inverse table rows
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower head between hands

exercises.name: Alternating superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm + left leg, alternate

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring foot toward opposite hand by rotating

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
